description: This file is a code-behind for a XAML UI component called GraphingNumPad in a calculator application. It manages UI interactions, button behaviors, visibility of trig functions, and communicates with the math editor component.

classes.name: GraphingNumPad
classes.description: A partial class representing the code-behind for the GraphingNumPad UI component, handling user interactions and UI logic.

methods.name: GraphingNumPad
methods.description: Constructor initializing the component and setting button contents based on localization settings.

methods.name: ShiftButton_Check
methods.description: Event handler for when the shift button is checked, updates UI visibility.

methods.name: ShiftButton_Uncheck
methods.description: Event handler for when the shift button is unchecked, resets UI and triggers button click.

methods.name: TrigFlyoutShift_Toggle
methods.description: Event handler for toggling the shift state of the trig flyout, updates trig function visibility.

methods.name: TrigFlyoutHyp_Toggle
methods.description: Event handler for toggling the hyp state of the trig flyout, updates trig function visibility.

methods.name: FlyoutButton_Clicked
methods.description: Handles clicks on flyout buttons, resets related toggle buttons and hides flyouts.

methods.name: ShiftButton_IsEnabledChanged
methods.description: Event handler for when the shift button's enabled state changes, updates UI visibility.

methods.name: SetOperatorRowVisibility
methods.description: Updates the visibility of operator rows based on shift button state.

methods.name: SetTrigRowVisibility
methods.description: Updates the visibility of trig function rows based on shift and hyp button states.

methods.name: Button_Clicked
methods.description: Handles number and function button clicks, inserts corresponding text into math editor.

methods.name: SubmitButton_Clicked
methods.description: Handles submit button click, submits the current equation.

methods.name: BackSpaceButton_Clicked
methods.description: Performs backspace operation in the math editor.

methods.name: GraphingNumPad_PointerPressed
methods.description: Handles pointer pressed events to prevent focus movement.

methods.name: GetActiveRichEdit
methods.description: Retrieves the currently focused math rich edit control.

methods.name: Flyout_Opening
methods.description: Sets the flyout show mode to transient when opening.
